assessment_scores_absent_has_no_result.name: assessment_scores_absent_has_no_result
assessment_scores_absent_has_no_result.value: NOT "assessment_scores"."is_absent" OR ("assessment_scores"."raw_score" IS NULL AND "assessment_scores"."level" IS NULL)

report_cards_attendance_sane.name: report_cards_attendance_sane
report_cards_attendance_sane.value:
("report_cards"."attendance_present" IS NULL AND "report_cards"."attendance_total" IS NULL)
    OR ("report_cards"."attendance_present" >= 0 AND "report_cards"."attendance_total" >= "report_cards"."attendance_present")

report_cards_released_after_finalised.name: report_cards_released_after_finalised
report_cards_released_after_finalised.value: "report_cards"."released_at" IS NULL OR "report_cards"."finalised_at" IS NOT NULL
